messages.snippet: James, Our mark-up attached (tracked). Principal points for Aerelon: extend exclusivity to seven yea
messages.subject: Project Indigo - Licence mark-up (v2)
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Our mark-up attached (tracked). Principal points for Aerelon: extend exclusivity to seven years; reduce the minimum annual royalty to £900k; raise the general liability cap to 150% of fees; increase the IP indemnity cap to £15m; and reduce default interest to 2% over base. The rest is largely agreed. Let's find a time to talk the commercials through.

Alistair
Pemberton Rowe LLP
